note: Rewritten from the original English description by Sands (1959); the original is in English, the alate is described for the first time in that paper (recorded in the original as Previously undescribed), and the soldier is only supplemented with measurements; the scan reads decimal points as colons (e.g. "o-86—-0-93"), the measurements are restored from the range columns and no means are adopted; distribution data given in the original, such as specimens taken from the surface of Macrotermes bellicosus mounds and a Nyasaland soldier record that could not be confirmed, are not included in this entry.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Colour: head and pronotum sepia brown, postclypeus paler, yellowish brown; antennae pale yellowish brown, labrum pale yellow; thoracic sclerites (except the pronotum), legs and the small spots on the sides of the abdominal sternites pale yellowish brown, the rest of the sternites yellowish white; abdominal tergites pale sepia brown; wings semi-transparent pale brown, the subcosta and most of the radial sector pale yellow, the base of the radial sector sepia brown with a narrow sepia brown stripe running parallel and adjacent to it along the posterior margin, the remaining veins brown. Posterior margin of the head almost semicircular; fontanelle pale, broadly oval to nearly circular, slightly smaller than an ocellus, weakly concave; eye as long as the postclypeus; ocelli small, the distance to the eye equal to or slightly less than the width of an ocellus; postclypeus weakly inflated, length slightly more than half the width, posterior margin evenly convex, anterior margin straight; the third marginal tooth of the left mandible distinctly projecting beyond the undulate cutting edge between it and the first marginal tooth, the apical tooth as long as the first marginal tooth; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 5 longer than segments 3 and 4 but shorter than segment 2. Pronotum narrower than the head width including eyes, anterior margin straight, sides broadly rounded, narrowing posteriorly to a slightly concave posterior margin. Sclerite hairs pale, fine and sparsely scattered; the hairs of the abdominal intersegmental membranes shorter, curved, evenly distributed and pale yellow. Male similar to female, but the wings slightly shorter. Measurements (mm): head width including eyes 0.86—0.93; maximum diameter of eye 0.21—0.23; ocelli 0.07—0.08 × 0.08—0.10; ocellus to eye 0.04—0.08; pronotum width 0.68—0.75, length 0.43—0.50; hind tibia length 0.82—0.89; forewing length 8.20—8.90.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: The specimens examined by Sands agree completely with Sjöstedt's original description; only measurements are added, together with a note that the fore coxa bears 2—3 small spines, and the range of size variation is greater than that recorded by Sjöstedt. Measurements (mm): head length 1.06—1.18; maximum head width 0.78—0.86; head width at the mandible base 0.66—0.72; head thickness 0.68—0.72; left mandible length 0.57—0.65; pronotum length 0.32; pronotum width 0.52—0.54; hind tibia length 0.68—0.70.
